name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a multi-site SSL-enabled web server serving three virtual hosts with self-signed TLS certificates, host hardening (fail2ban, UFW, sysctl, SSH), and runtime secret retrieval via CyberArk Conjur and OAuth2.

name: nginx_multisite
description: Ansible role equivalent of the Chef nginx-multisite cookbook, managing Nginx multi-site SSL configuration, host hardening, and credential injection via AAP custom credential types.
